mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of instances with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of instances with UNRATE > 5.0, or correlation between UNRATE > 5.0 and negative returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 3-month moving averages, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates manufacturing sector contraction that reduces corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns during supply shock regimes.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of supply shocks (INDPRO decline >2% in 3 months), or the INDPRO decline signal fails to outperform baseline returns (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 0.5% signals monetary tightening that increases corporate borrowing costs and depresses equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in >60% of instances with FEDFUNDS > 0.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 100,000 monthly net additions supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in >60% of instances with PAYEMS growth >100,000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1200.0 thousand units signals strong residential construction activity that boosts consumer confidence and corporate revenue, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of instances with HOUST > 1200.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 102.0 indicates manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate output and profit growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in >60% of instances with INDPRO decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
